field_overrides.path: (no template field) density / flash point / KV100 / handling
field_overrides.cmp_override: the component template (json_templates/additive_component_all_general.json) has fields function, chemical_family, active_content, carrier, treat_rate, compatibility_restrictions and function_specific_markers (tbn, ca, mg, p, zn, mo) only: NO density, kinematic viscosity, flash point or handling field (schema gap). The record already keeps these properties in open_questions, which is the established place: (1) 'Printed properties with no field in the component template (HiTEC 12204L PDS 06/17, p.2, column HiTEC 12250 ...): Density, lbs/gal. 7.67; Specific Gravity @ 15.6/15.6 C 0.920; Viscosity @ 100 C, cSt 175; Flash Point, C (PMCC) 135 min.'; (2) 'Handling information ...: Max Handling Temp: 70 C; Shelf Life: 3 months @ 45 C, 36 months @ ambient (10-40 C).'
field_overrides.overlap_reviewed: already in open_questions: KV100 175 (cSt there, mm2/s here), Max Handling Temp 70 C, 36 months at ambient. Genuinely new from the product's own 04/19 bulletin: density 0.920 g/ml at 15 C (the old note has 0.920 as specific gravity 15.6/15.6 C, a different quantity); flash point printed '>135' (old: '135 min.'); 'Max Storage Temp: 50 C' (absent from the old note); the '3 months @ 45 C' shelf-life line is absent. Narrowed to updating those two open_questions entries; no template change and no field is forced.
field_overrides.reason: Schema gap documented (no component field for density, viscosity, flash point, storage or handling). Proposal limited to the open_questions entries that already hold these properties.
